title: temper theme
description: A theme is data: values for every role in the contract. Components consume roles, never values; a theme that omits a role or invents one does not validate.

name.description: Stable identifier; also the value of data-theme.

appearance.description: Sets color-scheme; selects this theme when the system appearance matches and the person follows it.

counterpart.description: The theme of the opposite appearance that pairs with this one.

ground.description: The page/window ground. Everything else is composited over it.

surface.description: Panels, cards, docked peeks — a lifted fill over ground.

surface-raised.description: Popovers, menus, the command palette — one step above surface.

text.description: Primary reading text. Floor: 7:1 on ground and surface.

text-muted.description: Secondary text — decks, body in dense chrome. Floor: 4.5:1.

text-subtle.description: Tertiary text — mono labels, metadata strips, counts. Floor: 4.5:1.

text-faint.description: Disabled and decorative only; never carries information. Floor: 2.5:1.

rule-strong.description: Dividers that must survive a busy surface; input outlines.

accent.description: The single accent: section labels, the rail, links, primary actions. Floor: 4.5:1.

accent-muted.description: Accent at rest where full accent would shout (secondary links, idle markers).

accent-line.description: Accent borders on buttons and focused inputs.

accent-line-soft.description: The rail motif and soft accent borders.

on-accent.description: Text on a solid accent fill. Floor: 4.5:1 on accent.

focus.description: Keyboard focus ring. Floor: 3:1 on ground.

notice.description: A condition that wants the reader's attention (not a failure). Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

success.description: A completed act confirmed. Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

danger.description: Destructive affordances (delete, retract). Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

pending.description: Pending state — proposals awaiting ratification, threads addressed to you. State, not alarm. Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

region-arriving.description: Region state: a read in flight. Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

region-empty.description: Region state: the read succeeded and there is nothing. Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

region-gave-up.description: Region state: the system stopped waiting. A hue nothing else uses. Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

region-failed.description: Region state: the read failed. Floor: 4.5:1 on its wash.

author-human.description: Authorship gutter mark for a person. Floor: 3:1 on ground.

author-agent.description: Authorship gutter mark for an agent acting on someone's behalf. Floor: 3:1 on ground.

cat-1.description: Categorical slot 1 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-2.description: Categorical slot 2 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-3.description: Categorical slot 3 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-4.description: Categorical slot 4 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-5.description: Categorical slot 5 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-6.description: Categorical slot 6 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-7.description: Categorical slot 7 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-8.description: Categorical slot 8 of 8. Vocabularies — core's doc types and plugins' — bind their terms to slots; they never name colours. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

cat-neutral.description: The categorical mark bound to no slot: a doc type no vocabulary binds, or a tint deliberately unnamed. Floor: 4.5:1 on ground, 3:1 on surface.

code-key.description: Syntax: keys, attributes, names. Floor: 4.5:1 on surface.

code-number.description: Syntax: numbers, literals, keywords. Floor: 4.5:1 on surface.

doing.description: Doing face — labels, commands, code, metadata.

ui.description: Dense UI face — grids, form controls.

panel.description: Panels and cards. The editorial default is 0.

color.description: #rrggbb or rgba(r, g, b, a). No named colours, no hsl — the contrast check reads these.

fontStack.description: A CSS font-family list. Fonts are bundled by each surface, never fetched — a surface must be able to render offline.
